Also note about "tenth and hundredth digit"? Might refer to rounding to two decimal places. So we round to two decimals.

1. Call compute_exchange_rate with base_currency="RMB", target_currency="USD", value=20000.
2. Round result to two decimals.
3. Call set_budget_limit with access_token=abc123xyz, budget_limit=<rounded>.

Let's proceed.
